entities.name: Ramón María Narváez, 1st Duke of Valencia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ramón María Narváez y Campos, 1st Duke of Valencia was a Spanish general and statesman who served as Prime Minister on several occasions during the reign of Isabella II. He was also known in Spain as El Espadón de Loja, "The Longsword of Loja".
